About Justin

I'm a therapist trying to put myself out of a job.

I love working with people as a therapist and as a coach. It's deeply fulfilling, and an honor to be part of someone's mental health getting better.

And yet, I'm on a mission to make myself unnecessary. I want to give you every self-regulation skill you need to get unstuck and live the fulfilling life you deserve.

Hi, I'm Justin

I'm dedicated to mental health and trauma recovery. Since 2007, I've worked with individuals, couples, and families, helping them with trauma, substance use, relationship issues, self-harm, and more.

I'm a licensed marriage and family therapist and a member of the Polyvagal Institute Editorial Board, and since 2019 I've been teaching Polyvagal Theory in plain English on the Stuck Not Broken podcast. If you're exploring the practical uses of Polyvagal Theory, you're in the right place.

I'm a proud father of two, a devoted husband, and a coffee lover. In my spare time, I appreciate Swiss-style design, cheer on the 49ers, and enjoy everything Seinfeld.

My mission

I want to change how the world understands mental health, and move us away from abstract psychobabble.

Psychology has neglected the body for decades. Instead, the field has focused on new labels for the people seeking help, on changing thoughts, training behavior, and building insight, indefinitely.

How I help
  • I teach the basics of Polyvagal Theory simply and clearly, without shame, blame, or judgment.
  • I teach you how to feel safe in your body, so you can breathe easier and be in the present moment.
  • I teach you how to release inner pain and find more emotional freedom.
  • I make free resources with clear design and plain language.

Stuck, not broken

I know you feel broken. But you're not.

I think you're a normal person who likely lived through abnormal life circumstances. Like many of my clients, you may just be stuck in your body's defenses. The good news is that if you're stuck, you're ready to move forward and make the changes you want for yourself.

You just need to figure out how to get unstuck. My goal is to teach you the simple lessons and essential skills to do it.
